# House of Sillage

> > House of Sillage: Ultra-luxury perfume and beauty brand featuring Swarovski crystal-adorned fragrances, cosmetics, and exclusive collaborations with Disney, Batman, and Harry Potter.

House of Sillage specializes in collectible luxury fragrances and beauty products, distinguished by their ornate Swarovski crystal packaging and artisanal formulations. The brand offers signature perfume collections, limited edition collaborations, designer lip products, scented candles, and curated discovery sets for discerning collectors.

## Key Topics

- Luxury Perfume & Fragrances
- Swarovski Crystal Packaging
- Disney Collaborations (Mickey & Friends)
- Batman 85th Anniversary Collection
- Harry Potter Collection
- Signature Collection Parfums
- Travel Spray Refills
- Diamond Lipstick & Lip Balm
- Limited Edition Releases
- Mystery Vault Gift Sets
- Scented Candle Collection
- Women's & Men's Fragrances
- Arabesque Collection
- Passion de L'Amour
- Tiara & Benevolence Fragrances
